description: React component for the RHS header in Mattermost, managing thread actions, navigation, and UI controls.

classes.name: RhsHeaderPost
classes.description: React component class for the RHS header, handling UI interactions and thread controls.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Handles back navigation based on previous RHS state.

methods.name: handleJumpClick
methods.description: Handles jump to the post in the thread, closing RHS on mobile.

methods.name: handleFollowChange
methods.description: Toggles follow/unfollow state for the thread.

methods.name: popout
methods.description: Opens the thread in a popout window.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the RHS header UI with controls and tooltips.
